names.form: Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Ιερομάρτυρας, επίσκοπος Αλεξανδρείας
names.note: saint.gr calls him hieromartyr and bishop of Alexandria, but notes with Eustratiades that this is a mistake and he was a simple devout Christian — no Theodore appears in the list of patriarchs before Theodore I the Scribe (608–610).
Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 3 decembrie, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Teodor, Arhiepiscopul Alexandriei», with the rank words and the see left off.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 12 сентября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Феодора еп. Александрийского»

feast.note: The Romanian calendar keeps him on a different day from the Greek and the Russian, which have him on 12 September; doxologia.ro prints him on 3 decembrie and serves under that line the same life — the crown of thorns, the blows on the eyes, the mockery and the beheading at the ruler's order.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 3 decembrie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Teodor, Arhiepiscopul Alexandriei»
Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 12 Σεπτεμβρίου — «Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Ιερομάρτυρας, επίσκοπος Αλεξανδρείας»

attestations.note: Not checked: pravoslavno.rs was read for 23 August – 19 September 2026 (10 August – 6 September ст. ст.); its page for 12. септембар ст. ст. was not read (2026-08-23).
